news.headline: Holani still figures to get most of his playing time on passing downs but could take on more carries in the absence of P
news.detail: Holani still figures to get most of his playing time on passing downs but could take on more carries in the absence of Price. The Seahawks also have Jacardia Wright and Velus Jones as backfield options on the practice squad, so Emanuel Wilson and Holani won't automatically get all of the snaps.
